mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, version, timestamp, event_data FROM event_store WHERE aggregate_id = #{aggregateId} ORDER BY version ASC
SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, version, timestamp, event_data FROM event_store WHERE aggregate_id = #{aggregateId} AND version > #{fromVersion} ORDER BY version ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_store (event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, version, timestamp, event_data) VALUES (#{eventId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{version}, #{timestamp}, #{eventData})
